title: Check both provider call identity and output position before coalescing observations
trigger: provider search streaming output index call identity cumulative call ceiling deduplication
guidance: Lifecycle updates may coalesce by call ID or output position only when their other known identity field agrees. Matching either field while ignoring a contradictory other field can collapse two reported calls into one and bypass the call ceiling. Retain both conflicting observations and fail client delivery. Bounded omissions of present external query/title fields must set the truncation flag; absence and discarded data are different evidence states.

evidence.revision: P06 implementation based on e9d050a; recorded with this source change
evidence.note: Duplicate ID across positions and different IDs at one position reject with retained observations; oversized present query/title fields mark bounded omissions. Independent review found the original defects, then protocol fixtures verified the corrections.

recheck: Recheck if native call identity, lifecycle indexing, coalescing or provider call-ceiling semantics change. Local fixtures do not establish live-provider accounting or host budget enforcement.
